2020_155_jun_2020_pcard_report.paragraph: Troy School District's purchasing-card (PCARD) transaction listing for June 2020, printed 8/12/2020 over nine pages and carried on the Board of Education agenda for August 18, 2020. Each line records a transaction date and abbreviated merchant name, the journal-entry label "JUN PCARD EXPENSE," a fifteen-digit budget unit, an account code, and either a transaction amount or a credit. The report closes with a subtotal of 140,028.19 in charges against 9,881.12 in credits and Total Expenses of 130,147.07. The largest single charges are 6,500.00 to ROSY BROS IN, 5,175.00 to SQ ANTHONY, 5,161.99 to B&H PHOTO 80, and 4,701.00 to WRIGHT TOOL.

2020_157_8_b_construction_and_technology.paragraph: Slide deck titled "Troy School District Capital Projects — Bond, BSSF and TLC Fund, Projects Update September 2020," presented as agenda item 8.B. at the Board of Education meeting of September 15, 2020. It inventories the 2020 building, site, roof, flooring and annual maintenance projects, displays completion matrices for the 2014 Bond at elementary and secondary buildings, and closes with Summer 2020 technology bond work. The technology section notes that the order of keyboard cases for all new iPads has been on backorder since July 15, with Apple then estimating the cases would ship by September 15.
2020_157_8_b_construction_and_technology.page:
**Deck identity**
"Troy School District Capital Projects — Bond, BSSF and TLC Fund, Projects Update September 2020." Agenda item 8.B., Board of Education meeting September 15, 2020. A later section is headed "Technology Bond Projects — Summer 2020 — September 15, 2020 Board of Education Meeting." No dollar figures appear in the extracted text.

**2020 Bond/BSSF building improvement projects**
- Hill and Wattles Elementary Schools: mechanical upgrades (boilers, unit ventilators and HVAC units), electrical upgrades (panels and fire alarm systems), kiln room construction
- Athens High School: pool upgrades and art room renovation
- Costello, Martell and IAE: stage renovation with ADA accessible ramp and operable partitions
- Costello, Martell and Wattles: removal of in-wall cafe tables
- Boulan and Larson: window and door replacement
- Bemis: gym/cafe operable wall replacement
- Troy Union: ADA lift project in the kindergarten wing area
- Niles Relocation Project
- Building renovation of the new TSD Learning Center

**Site improvement projects**
IAE parking lot replacement/redesign including removal of tennis courts and new LED lighting; Athens student parking lot replacement/redesign with a new dedicated entry and exit; THS main entrance parking area improvement; Hill paved play and sidewalk replacements.

**Roof, flooring and maintenance**
Roof replacements at Athens (pool and main gym roofs), IAE (academic areas, main office and TCT) and Troy High (academic wings, counseling offices, auditorium seating and lobby areas). Flooring replacements at Hill and Wattles (classrooms and gym), IAE (cafeteria and stage), and polished concrete and terrazzo at Athens, Smith, Costello and Martell. 2020_157_8_b_construction_and_technology.verbose:
Agenda item 8.B. at the Troy Board of Education meeting of September 15, 2020 is a PowerPoint deck titled "Troy School District Capital Projects — Bond, BSSF and TLC Fund — Projects Update September 2020." It reviews work funded through the district's bond program, the BSSF (Building and Site Sinking Fund) and the TLC Fund, then moves to a separate section headed "Technology Bond Projects, Summer 2020, September 15, 2020 Board of Education Meeting." The extracted text contains no dollar amounts, contract awards or vote records; the deck is a project inventory with photographs and status matrices.

2020 Bond/BSSF Building Improvement Projects. Hill and Wattles Elementary Schools receive mechanical upgrades covering boilers, unit ventilators and HVAC units, together with electrical upgrades covering panels and fire alarm systems, plus kiln room construction. Athens High School receives pool upgrades and an art room renovation. Costello, Martell and IAE receive stage renovation consisting of an ADA accessible ramp and operable partitions. Costello, Martell and Wattles have in-wall cafe tables removed. Boulan and Larson receive window and door replacement. Bemis receives gym/cafe operable wall replacement. Troy Union receives an ADA lift project in the kindergarten wing area. The list also includes the Niles Relocation Project and building renovation of the new TSD Learning Center.

Site Improvement Projects. IAE receives parking lot replacement and redesign, including removal of tennis courts and new LED lighting. Athens receives student parking lot replacement and redesign with a new dedicated entry and exit. THS receives main entrance parking area improvement. Hill receives paved play and sidewalk replacements.

Roof Replacement Projects. Athens (pool and main gym roofs); IAE (academic areas, main office and TCT); Troy High (academic wings, counseling offices, auditorium seating and lobby areas).

Flooring Replacement Projects. Hill and Wattles (classrooms and gym); IAE (cafeteria and stage); Athens, Smith, Costello and Martell (polished concrete and terrazzo).

Annual Maintenance Projects. District-wide concrete replacement; district-wide asphalt patch, sealcoating and parking lot striping; district-wide fencing replacement and improvements; district-wide brick/block repair and tuckpointing.

Photographic slides carry captions for Hill and Wattles Elementary School mechanical/electrical upgrades, doors and windows and kiln room construction; Athens High School art room improvements covering ceiling, lights, casework and polished floor; Athens Natatorium improvements covering open ceiling, LED lighting, expanded windows and tile replacement; IAE, Martell and Costello stage renovations with operable wall replacement and ADA ramp construction; IAE, Martell and Wattles in-wall cafe table removal; Boulan and Larson exterior window and door replacement; Troy Union ADA lift project; Troy School District Learning Center building renovation; Athens, IAE, THS, Hill and Schroeder parking lot and pavement replacements; Athens, IAE and Troy High roof replacements with separate views of Troy High and International Academy East; BSSF flooring replacements at International Academy East and Wattles Elementary School; BSSF flooring replacement and polishing at Hill Gym and the Smith science room; BSSF floor polishing at the Athens health room and a Costello hallway; concrete addition and replacements; and fencing and sealcoating/striping at Larson Middle and the Martell kindergarten play area.

2014 Bond matrices. An elementary matrix, headed "2014 Bond – ES/Matrix," runs Barnard, Bemis, Costello, Hamilton, Hill, Leonard, Martell, Morse, Schroeder, Troy Union, Wass and Wattles against the project rows Create Secure Entry Vestibule; Modify Main Office as Secure Welcome Center; Electronic Access System; Walkway Replacements; Parking Lot Lighting Upgrades; Parking Lot Additions/Upgrades; Roofing Replacement; Door & Window Upgrades; Exterior Lighting Upgrades; Building Automation System Upgrades; Building/Classroom Equipment Upgrades; Electrical System Infrastructure Upgrades; Fire Alarm System Upgrades; and Emergency Lighting System Upgrades. Category bands are Safety & Security, Electrical, HVAC, Exterior Upgrades and Site Upgrades, and the legend marks "Project Completed."

A secondary matrix, headed "2014 Bond – Secondaries/Matrix," runs Baker, Boulan Park, Larson, Smith, Athens, Troy High, I.A. East and Niles against the same core rows plus Roofing Areas Replacement, Building Exterior Lighting Upgrades, and a block of Individual Enhancement Projects: Convert Pool Locker Rooms into Storage; Increase Gymnasium Seating Capacity; Locker Room Remodel; Old Office Conversion/Remodel; Performing Arts and Music Room Storage/Support; Four Classroom Addition to Replace Aging Portables; Auditorium Upgrades; Collaboration/LGI Room Remodeling; Restroom Upgrades in 12 Locations; TCCHS Restroom Upgrade; and TCT Kitchen Improvements. The legend for this matrix distinguishes "Project Completed" and "Cancelled," and notes that if a cell has no color it was not included as part of scope.

Technology Bond Projects, Summer 2020. Board Room AV upgrades under Services are listed as completed work: replaced control room hardware, replaced cameras, replaced cabling, replaced projector, and replaced side and podium displays, with a following slide of Board Room AV updates. The district-wide PA system upgrade is marked in progress and involves replacing 20-year-old paging hardware and software in all buildings and updating cabling and amplifiers to bypass outdated classroom control panels. Security camera hardware and software upgrades and additions are also marked in progress: adding one camera at a main entrance; at the middle schools, replacing existing cameras and adding additional cameras to improve coverage areas; at IA East, replacing existing cameras and adding cameras in the new addition; and at TLC, installing interior and exterior cameras.

Device deployment covers elementary and preschool iPads. The district ordered iPads to expand 1:1 in grades K, 1 and 2; ordered iPads with keyboard cases to expand 1:1 in grades 11 and 12; ordered iPads with keyboard cases for grades 3, 8 and 9; ordered iPads with keyboard cases for teachers; and ordered and installed keyboard cases on existing iPads for students in grades 4 through 7. A closing note states that the order of keyboard cases for all new iPads has been on backorder since July 15, and that the current estimate from Apple is that cases will ship by September 15.
